_format: Every piece of art the mod needs besides the card portraits (those come from cards.json). kind picks the recipe in scripts/art_recipes.py (style references, prompt template, size, post-processing, output paths). art = what to draw. Step 7.5, 2026-09-23.

character.name: Character select button
character.art: a character select portrait bust of THE_DONALD, three-quarter view, chin raised with a smug confident expression, on a solid flat saturated golden yellow background

character.name: Character select screen
character.art: THE_DONALD standing heroically on the right half of the frame, seen from a low angle, a golden shovel resting on his shoulder and his red tie flapping in the wind, in front of a towering wall of gold-trimmed bricks under a dramatic crimson and gold sky with drifting embers. The left 40 percent of the image is calm dark crimson background with no subject, leaving room for menu text
